import re, json
from pathlib import Path

def merge_jsonl_conflict(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    if '<<<<<<< HEAD' not in text:
        return False
    parts = re.split(r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n', text, maxsplit=1)
    before = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    head_main = rest.split('\n=======\n', 1)
    head = head_main[0]
    main_and_after = head_main[1].split('\n>>>>>>> origin/main\n', 1)
    main = main_and_after[0]
    after = main_and_after[1] if len(main_and_after) > 1 else ''
    lines = [l for l in (before + head + main + after).splitlines() if l.strip()]
    def ts_key(line):
        try:
            return json.loads(line).get('ts', '')
        except Exception:
            return line
    lines_sorted = sorted(set(lines), key=ts_key)
    Path(path).write_text('\n'.join(lines_sorted) + ('\n' if lines_sorted else ''))
    return True

for p in Path('docs/dev-audit').rglob('2026-10-08.jsonl'):
